issues.issue: Was the officer's H&C decision reasonable, given the weight given to the circumstances of the loss of employment (Kanthasamy)?
issues.applicant_position: Officer gave only little weight to the fraud and abuse behind the job loss, contrary to Kanthasamy, and paid lip service to it.
issues.result_quote: the officer’s decision to ascribe only little weight to the appalling circumstances surrounding the loss of Ms. Kaur’s employment in Canada was not, in my view, consistent
